summary: Iter 32 deploy-hardening sprint validated end-to-end. Backend: 39/39 pytest PASS (12 iter32 + 16 iter31 + 11 iter30 sprint tests). Verified: forgot-password enumeration guard (200 identical message for known+unknown emails), OutboxMessage row queued with template='password_reset' for real users, reset-password rejects garbage tokens with 400, full flow register→request→consume→new-pw-login succeeds/old-pw-login fails, change-password rejects wrong current with 400 + accepts correct with 200 + clears must_change_password, admin login carries must_change_password=true / learner=false, security headers present on /api/health (X-Frame-Options=DENY, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy geolocation/microphone/camera/payment/usb/magnetometer/gyroscope/accelerometer all disabled, CSP-Report-Only with frame-ancestors 'none', HSTS max-age=31536000 present via HTTPS ingress), Sentry no-op verified (get_client().dsn falsy), deploy_precheck fail-closed on unset ENVIRONMENT (exit 1), soft-advisor on ENVIRONMENT=development (exit 0). Frontend E2E on preview URL: (a) /login shows 'Forgot your password?' link -> href=/forgot-password. (b) /forgot-password renders, accepts any email, submits, renders 'Check your inbox' confirmation card. (c) /reset-password/:token renders 'Pick a new password' form, validates mismatch ('Passwords do not match') + min-length ('at least 8 characters'), and on bad-token submit shows red toast 'Reset failed — the link may be expired.' (backend returns 400 as expected). (d) CRITICAL: admin@ifpi.org login redirects to /change-password?forced=1 with amber 'Password change required' banner rendering. Protected route gate blocks /dashboard until password is changed — confirmed. (e) learner@ifpi.org login goes straight to /courses (no redirect). No admin password mutation performed; browser cookies cleared for cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/auth.py — Clean 3-endpoint addition (change/forgot/reset). Enumeration guard is correct: constant 200 response regardless of email match, and reset link only assembled when result is truthy. Reset-password auto-issues fresh tokens after consume (good UX). API-token principals correctly blocked from /change-password (negative id check).

services/auth_service.py — request_password_reset invalidates outstanding tokens before issuing a new one (prevents parallel-token attacks). token_urlsafe(32) raw + sha256 hash stored (only hash in DB — good). consume_password_reset checks used_at + expires_at + user.is_active, revokes all refresh tokens after success. change_password revokes all refresh tokens too. All correct security posture.

scripts/deploy_precheck.py — Fail-closed on unset/unknown ENVIRONMENT (line 275-279) is exactly the SureThing AI ask: 'unset' now treated as production, forcing an explicit ENVIRONMENT=development to unlock soft-advisor. Verified both branches via pytest.
Sentry init in server.py is guarded by SENTRY_DSN env — sentry_sdk.get_client().dsn is falsy after import when unset (verified in test_sentry_noop_when_dsn_unset).
core/middleware.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware — All 5 required headers on /api/health + HSTS (via HTTPS ingress). Non-prod uses CSP-Report-Only (correct for the preview environment).

ForgotPasswordPage.tsx / ResetPasswordPage.tsx / ChangePasswordPage.tsx — All render cleanly, have proper client-side validation (match + min-8), backend integration confirmed via network + toast messages. ChangePasswordPage's amber 'Password change required' banner uses forced=1 query param correctly.
App.tsx Protected route gate — Verified: admin cannot reach /dashboard until must_change_password=false. Even direct URL navigation to /dashboard bounces back to /change-password?forced=1.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 iter32 E2E flows pass: login link, forgot, reset, admin forced-redirect, learner no-redirect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 32 certified green. Notes: (1) Admin @ifpi.org retains admin123 — the seed_admin update path leaves must_change_password=True so future logins keep triggering the forced redirect. If a test ever *does* complete the change-password flow for admin, re-seed via `python /app/backend/seed/seed_minimal.py` to restore admin123 + must_change_password=true. (2) Password reset tokens live in table `password_reset_tokens` (used_at, expires_at, token_hash sha256, requested_ip). (3) The /reset-password/:token frontend page correctly toasts 'Reset failed — the link may be expired.' — the exact wording 'Invalid or expired token' comes from the backend but the frontend translates it. (4) SecurityHeadersMiddleware uses CSP-Report-Only in non-prod (preview) and CSP enforce in prod (ENVIRONMENT=production). HSTS only appears when x-forwarded-proto=https (it does on the preview URL). (5) Sentry stays silent unless SENTRY_DSN is set; do NOT rely on Sentry breadcrumbs in tests. (6) deploy_precheck: run without --strict when ENVIRONMENT unset → exits 1. Pass ENVIRONMENT=development for exit 0.
